replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states dashboards query with analyst credentials; viewers inherit privileged access to salary/health tables."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Link sharing to anyone in company is in design; leaked URL exposes HR data."},{"id":"T3","keep":false,"reason":"Same unauthorized viewer reading row-level salary/health data via shared dashboards as T2.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: repeated query refreshes consume warehouse compute, harming other jobs."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Never-expiring links in design; leavers retain access — distinct lifetime/revocation attack."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Attribution of health/salary access to analyst is specific to stated credential design."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Share action itself unlogged; named sharing feature, distinct from query-log attribution in T6."}]}
